title: break(cli): upgrade Commander to v15 (AI-assisted)
body:
## Breaking Changes

Upgrading Commander from v5 to v15. 

Most plugins shouldn't be affected.

Even if they use the `extendCli()` lifecycle hook there should be zero change, or they should be very minimal. In our case, we only had to adjust imports in plugin CLI unit tests, that's all (see PR diff)

See the [Commander changelog](https://github.com/tj/commander.js/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for details that may affect your custom plugin CLI extensions.

Compatibility settings preserve parts of the historical behavior:

```ts
cli.storeOptionsAsProperties(true).allowExcessArguments(true);
```


Remaining upstream changes include, not exhaustively:
- single-character short flags (`-t`, not `-to`)
- `Command` replacing `CommanderStatic`
- removal of `.passCommandToAction()`
- the trailing action argument becoming a command rather than an excess-arguments array. 


## Pre-flight checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines on pull requests](https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
- [x] **If this is a code change**: I have written unit tests and/or added dogfooding pages to fully verify the new behavior.
- [ ] **If this is a new API or substantial change**: the PR has an accompanying issue and the maintainers have approved on my working plan. (Maintainer-requested upgrade; no separate issue.)

## Motivation

Upgrade all four direct Commander dependencies to `^15.0.0` while preserving common `extendCli` plugin behavior with `.storeOptionsAsProperties(true)` and `.allowExcessArguments(true)`. Create a fresh CLI per invocation, update imports/types, and point the plugin API documentation to Commander 15.

(AI-assisted)

## Test Plan

- Full test suite: 184 files / 2,984 tests passed.
- All 36 buildable packages passed `pnpm build:packages`.
- CLI suite: 17 tests passed, including legacy and modern plugin actions, nested commands, excess arguments, async actions, and built-in option parsing. Re-ran after scoping command spies to the internal-command tests.
- Targeted ESLint, formatting, spelling, dependency consistency, and diff checks passed; pre-commit checks passed.
- Compiled CLI smoke tests: website help, docs-version help, create-docusaurus help/version, and TypeScript scaffolding with a custom destination and `--skip-install`.

### Test links

Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-12466--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/

- [Updated plugin API documentation](https://deploy-preview-12466--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/docs/api/plugin-methods/extend-infrastructure#extendCli)

## Related issues/PRs

None.
